en.visible_disclosure: The full interface is not translated: guide text remains in Russian; DISARM names and descriptions keep their source wording where no reviewed translation exists.

number_rules.decimals: preserve source precision; do not invent precision

unit_rules.measurement: show source unit next to value

copy_rules.line_break: wrap at word boundaries; never overflow the viewport
copy_rules.empty: Ничего не найдено. Измените запрос или сбросьте фильтры.
copy_rules.error: Не удалось загрузить данные. Проверьте подключение и повторите попытку.
copy_rules.source_enum_projection: The raw source value Unknown is rendered as a locale-specific explicit absence label; the original value remains unchanged in data/disarm.json.

translation_boundary: Russian-authored guide copy remains primary, including most explanatory text in the About view. DISARM names and descriptions preserve source wording where no reviewed translation exists. Kazakh and English localize navigation, workspace controls and data-state copy only; do not present them as full product translations.
